allow: PowerShell($url = 'https://alugridx-website.onrender.com'; foreach \($path in @\('/', '/health', '/api/products'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri \($url + $path\) -TimeoutSec 30 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output \("{0,-20} HTTP {1}  {2} bytes" -f $path, $r.StatusCode, $r.Content.Length\); $preview = $r.Content; if \($preview.Length -gt 200\) { $preview = $preview.Substring\(0,200\) + '...' }; Write-Output "  body: $preview"; Write-Output '' } catch { Write-Output \("{0,-20} ERROR: {1}" -f $path, $_.Exception.Message\); Write-Output '' } })

PowerShell($url = 'https://alugridx-website.onrender.com'; foreach \($path in @\('/', '/health', '/api/products'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri \($url + $path\) -TimeoutSec 60 -UseBasicParsing -Headers @{'Origin'='https://alugridx-website.vercel.app'}; Write-Output \('--- ' + $path + ' ---'\); Write-Output \('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode\); Write-Output \('Content-Type: ' + $r.Headers['Content-Type']\); Write-Output \('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: ' + $r.Headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin']\); $preview = $r.Content; if \($preview.Length -gt 250\) { $preview = $preview.Substring\(0,250\) + '...' }; Write-Output \('body: ' + $preview\); Write-Output '' } catch { Write-Output \('--- ' + $path + ' ---'\); Write-Output \('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message\); Write-Output '' } })

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("/api/projects","/api/blogs","/api/faqs"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://alugridx-website.onrender.com$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\): $\($r.Content.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(200,$r.Content.Length\)\)\)" } catch { "$p -> ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
